description: This file defines the PHP class SuiteEditorMozaik, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface. It manages the setup and rendering of a Mozaik-based suite editor within the SuiteCRM platform, including initializing dependencies and generating HTML output via Smarty templates.

classes.name: SuiteEditorMozaik
classes.description: A class that implements SuiteEditorInterface for rendering a Mozaik-based suite editor in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteEditorMozaik with optional settings and loads the SuiteMozaik dependency.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML code for the editor interface using Smarty templates.
